title: zotero-plugin-index entry fields
description: Fields of plugins/<id>/index.json: the data the index keeps beside the registry meta.json.

paidService.description: Set when a maintainer read that the plugin's main use stops without paying its maker, or stops after a trial. A lasting free plan with a paid upgrade, a plugin that also works with a third party's key, and a donation do not count.

note.description: What the plugin needs to be paid for, in English.

read.description: The date the maintainer read that page, as YYYY-MM-DD.

overrides.description: Corrections to upstream facts that the plugin author cannot or will not fix upstream. A description override can also give English text for a plugin whose manifest and GitHub descriptions are each missing, not in English, only repeat the name, or are half or more Chinese, Japanese, or Korean. It can also replace an English description of fewer than six words that the site shows without the override. A repository's owner can also ask for a name or description override, whatever the upstream text says.

value.description: For languages: one or more language tags joined by ", ", such as "zh-CN, en-US".

field.description: The upstream fact this override corrects or, for an English description or a text that the repository's owner asks for, fills in or replaces.

version.description: The plugin version the override applies to. Absent means every version.

reason.description: Why the upstream value is wrong, or, for English description text, the upstream source it was drawn from and, for the manifest and GitHub descriptions, whether each is missing, not in English, only repeats the name, has a CJK share of 0.5 or more as the README counts it, is in English with fewer than six words, or is in English and not shown. For a text that the repository's owner asks for, the issue that asks.
